title: Lua Registry-Based Pointer Injection
description: Each Lua API module stores its backing C++ system pointer in LUA_REGISTRYINDEX via a string key (e.g., 'uz_world', 'uz_time_manager'). A static GetSystem() helper retrieves the pointer. This decouples Lua C functions from global singletons — the API works regardless of how the system is instantiated. Injection happens after system init via LuaSet*(L, ptr) calls.
whenToUse: When creating new Lua API bindings for any C++ system. When the backing system is created after LuaVM::Init() and needs late binding.
whenNotToUse: For Lua-internal state that doesn't need C++ backing (pure Lua utilities). For systems that are always available (use uz global table directly).
